class_selection.message: The medallion hums as ancient power recognizes your potential. Choose your path carefully, for it will shape how you survive the road ahead.

1.text: Warrior - Hardened by struggle, powerful and resilient.

2.text: Rogue - Swift, precise, and difficult to kill.

3.text: Mage - Self-taught in arcane theory and magical deduction.

4.text: Wanderer - Fate bends strangely around you.

class_warrior.message: You choose the path of the Warrior. Your body is your weapon, and your strength will carve through adversity.

class_rogue.message: You choose the path of the Rogue. Speed, instinct, and precision are your greatest allies.

class_mage.message: You choose the path of the Mage. Knowledge is power, and even imperfect wisdom can shape destiny.

class_wanderer.message: You choose the path of the Wanderer. Fortune, chaos, and impossible coincidence walk beside you.

prologue_fall.message: A chaotic blend of static noise, tearing fabric, and fractal storms overwhelms your senses. You fall through impossible geometry before slamming into sudden calm. You gasp awake on a mossy forest floor beside a dead firepit, your nerves fried but intact. Your name is Ballan... and something is very wrong.

int_check_displacement.message: You force your overstimulated mind to process the impossible sensations.

success.text: This was no dream. The lingering ozone, magical distortion, and sensory inversion suggest spatial displacement magic. You steady yourself through logic.

failure.text: Your thoughts spiral into fractal madness. You try to comprehend infinity and instead black out permanently.

vertigo_death.message: Your brain melts under cosmic overstimulation. Ballan the bewildered dies before destiny even starts.

awaken_forest.message: Rain-washed earth, damp air, and dappled sunlight filter through ancient trees. Your supplies are neatly packed beside your bedroll. Then panic strikes—you remember the hidden medallion.

2.text: [DEX] Carefully inspect camp for danger first.

dex_check_camp.message: You swiftly scan the campsite perimeter before moving.

success.text: No thieves, no monsters—only a squirrel judges you from a branch. Your caution pays off.

failure.text: You trip over your own bedroll and smash your face into the firepit stones.

clumsy_death.message: A legendary destiny ends with an embarrassingly ordinary concussion.

medallion_check.message: You retrieve the silver clock-face medallion from your hidden pocket. For your entire life it never changed... until now. The hand points to XI. Eleven. Your destiny has begun.

1.text: [LUK] Deny reality and hope it's coincidence.

luk_check_denial.message: You convince yourself this is probably bad rabbit meat hallucination.

success.text: A sudden breeze flips the medallion back and forth, briefly obscuring the XI. You gain enough denial to stay calm... for now.

failure.text: You laugh hysterically, stumble backward into the road, and are immediately trampled by a wild boar.

bear_arrival.message: "I say, did it always look like that?" A shadow looms over you. You spin around to face an enormous bear in a cloak, hat, and boots.

1.text: Dive for your staff and attack!

2.text: [LUK] Attempt diplomacy and hope for the best.

luk_check_bear.message: You attempt diplomacy with the enormous wizard bear, hoping fate favors social survival.

success.text: "Nice boots," you blurt out. Boots gasps in delight. "Finally! Someone appreciates fashion!"

failure.text: You accidentally insult his hat. Boots looks so devastated that he unconsciously summons a falling tree.

sad_bear_death.message: Killed by emotional devastation and forestry.

attack_boots.message: You unleash a concussive blast. The bear lazily transforms it into bubbles.

str_check_bear.message: You charge a talking wizard bear. Bold. Possibly stupid.

success.text: You actually shove Boots half a step. He is so impressed he immediately offers mentorship and tea.

failure.text: Boots catches you, compliments your courage, then accidentally hugs you too hard.

hug_death.message: Crushed by affection. A rare but valid cause of death.

boots_tea.message: The bear introduces himself as Boots, Archmage, scholar, salmon enthusiast, and apparently your future mentor. Tea and magical cookware appear from nowhere.

2.text: [INT] Question the logic of his claims.

int_check_time.message: You critically examine Boots' bizarre explanation of future-you meeting past-him.

success.text: Against all reason... his paradox is internally consistent. You hate that this makes sense.

failure.text: You attempt to explain causality to a seven-hundred-year-old bear archmage. He counters flawlessly. Your pride dies instantly.

ego_death.message: Your body survives, but your intellectual self-esteem never recovers.

time_revelation.message: Boots reveals your future self already recruited him. Together, you are destined to uncover time travel.

2.text: [INT] Carefully determine if this destiny is real.

int_check_fate.message: You carefully analyze Boots' story, weighing logic against absurdity.

success.text: The paradox is insane... but internally consistent. This may actually be your destiny.

failure.text: You overthink yourself into indecision. Boots assumes refusal and vanishes, leaving you to a lifetime of regret.

missed_destiny_death.message: Not all deaths are physical. Some are simply the death of possibility.

the_accord.message: You drink enchanted tea and accept Boots as your master. Your gear packs itself by magic as Boots proudly declares your journey has begun.

prologue_end.message: You step onto the road beside Boots, Archmage of impossible credentials. For the first time, destiny feels less like a curse... and more like an adventure. PROLOGUE COMPLETE.
